title: ContourDiff: Unpaired Medical Image Translation with Structural Consistency
mechanism: A diffusion model trained only on the target domain maps contour maps to target images, enforcing the contour at every sampling step, so source structure and masks are preserved under translation.
adaptation: Train on unlabelled half-cut multi pool cells (1,152) plus CSIR mono pool; contour = busbar/finger/cell-border edges plus the crack label drawn in (edge detectors miss the 7% of cracks under 2% contrast). Translate the 478 train cells into half-cut CSIR style and reuse labels; crack is forced by its own label so pairs are aligned.
min_experiment: PF + 478 translated cells vs PF, 5 seeds. Metric E1 crack relF1@2 and E1 inactive IoU. Kill: both gains < +0.02 or test crack IoU drop > 0.01.
evidence: R: CT to MRI (lumbar spine, hip-thigh); segmentation trained on translated images beats other unpaired translators on real MRI; zero-shot to unseen anatomy.
prior_overlap: Synthetic half-cut views changed geometry only; appearance translation untested. Open.
